svg.aria-label: Twenty-five rows of demonstrated attacks on the verifier, rubric and platform across three review rounds, each paired with the rule that now closes it
svg.title: Attacks and their fixes
svg.text: Attacks the reviews demonstrated, and what closes them
Every row was a probe that made a verifier, the rubric or the platform do something it should not have. Each is now a failing test.
self-reported ledger summary granted Identity L2
I4 fails without the entries; a summary is not evidence

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: countersignatures never verified; garbage signatures scored 0.88
every entry verified under a pinned platform: or maintainer: key; others dropped

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: weight digest compared with the finder's own copy of an attestation
attestation is a provider-signed DSSE object under a pinned provider key

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: enclave key pinned in the keyring
the enclave key comes from the verified quote and nowhere else

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: two colluding keys reached the floor on day zero
pinned countersigner allowlist; age gate of 30 days

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: duplicates counted as positives; withdrawing penalised
neutral outcomes are excluded from the window

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: three canonicalisations, three ledger signing bodies
RFC 8785 everywhere; one DSSE payload type per object; one leaf definition

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: a receipt signed by the finder's own pinned key reached L2
I3 needs the platform: key named by intakeKey; E7 reads a receipt only after I3

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: another finder's published ledger counted as one's own
entries whose finder field is not this key are dropped

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: a Finding-track ledger granted Patch L2

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: entry order chosen by the finder swung the score 0.37 ↔ 0.93
the window is the last 50 by countersigned time; order cannot move the score

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: the platform's own appended entry was not enforced next time
the platform's own entry must be included; omission is a ledger-fork

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: two-operator accepted one root listed twice as 2-of-2
co-signers must be distinct pinned roots

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: duplicate JSON keys in a signed payload; ints beyond 2⁵³
payload must equal its own canonical form; duplicate keys rejected

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: “anchored in a log” claimed, never checked
require_anchor for third parties; the anchor verifies under a pinned log key

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: seq assigned by the platform forked honest finders (two cases, two platforms)
the finder owns the index; the platform checks inclusion, not position

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: key windows evaluated at times the checked party wrote; anchor time unused
one evaluation instant t_eval: anchor time, else receipt time, else now

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: successor and revoke cited as mitigations, implemented nowhere
successor chains history to the new key; an operator revoke fails I1 at t_eval

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: a pinned-key timestamp read as “anchored in a transparency log”
two named forms; require_anchor accepts inclusion, timestamps by opt-in

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: qudisclose keyed the ledger by reporter name; the spec by key and track
mirror, last_seen and own entries keyed by (finder key, track)

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: a deferred (not-attempted) submission was recorded as an over-claim
claimed and verified are written only when the platform re-executed

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: I4 passed or failed depending on the verifier's wall clock
the rubric is evaluated at t_eval; the verdict is a function of the inputs

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: audit trail, postmortem and advisory readable on embargoed cases
every read surface gated by the reporter-or-admin rule

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: one free duplicate entry made a fresh identity “known” to admission
only non-neutral verified entries count toward admission

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: a junk signature beside a valid one vetoed it; a 100 000-deep payload crashed verify()
any verifying signature under the keyid counts; payload size and depth are capped

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Rounds 1 and 2 found checks that compared against what the finder controls; round 3 found design questions the spec had not decided: who owns the index, which clock governs.
